Khardung La, then Diskit Monastery and a camel ride at the Hunder dunes
Pangong Tso, the lake that changes colour through the day
Hanle Observatory, one of the world's highest optical telescopes

overview:
About 800 km of high Himalaya, Leh to Leh: Khardung La and Nubra, Pangong Tso, Hanle's observatory, Umling La (the world's highest motorable road) and Tso Moriri, by bike or by car. It is a **7 Nights / 8 Days** fixed-departure group trip that starts and ends in Leh, with stays in hotels, camps and homestays and all listed meals included.

Travel in a sitting coach (SIC) or ride pillion on a Royal Enfield Himalayan for the same price, or ride solo with the bike for 6 days and fuel included. An oxygen cylinder rides in the car 24x7, with an RE mechanic with spares and a team captain throughout. Prices start at ₹26,500 per person on triple sharing (5% GST extra). Reserve your seat with ₹8,000 and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. In 2027, batches run every week from April to early November; call us for dates.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh
itinerary.content:
Get welcomed to the Land of High Passes by our representative.
Spend the day acclimatising to the cold; explore the local market and Shanti Stupa.
Overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, ride over Khardung La, one of the highest motorable passes in the world, with time at the top.
See the valley from Diskit Monastery, then take a double-humped camel ride at the Hunder sand dunes.
Dinner and overnight at camps or cottages.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso via Shyok
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, set off for Pangong Tso.
Arrive in the late afternoon at the lake that changes colour 4 to 5 times a day.
Spend the evening by the lake amid snow-capped peaks. Dinner and overnight at camps.

itinerary.title: Pangong Tso to Hanle
itinerary.content:
An 8 to 9 hour drive through Lukung and Chushul, close to the Indo-China border, into the Changthang region.
Visit the Hanle Observatory, one of the world's highest optical telescopes.
Ladakhi dinner and overnight at a homestay or hotel.

itinerary.title: Hanle to Umling La and back
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, head to Umling La, the world's highest motorable road.
Back in Hanle by evening for dinner and an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Hanle to Tso Moriri
itinerary.content:
Ride to Tso Moriri (14,000 ft) via the Nyoma-Mahe bridge.
Dinner and overnight at the campsite.

itinerary.title: Tso Moriri to Leh
itinerary.content:
Head back to Leh through romantic landscapes.
Shop at Leh market and try Ladakhi cuisine. Overnight at the hotel.

importantNotes:
- **Carry a valid government photo ID.** IDs are verified before boarding, and there is no boarding without one.
- **Arrive in Leh at least one day before the trip starts.** Under the government SOPs, all travellers must acclimatise in Leh for 48 hours. One day of acclimatisation is included in the package; the extra day before it is your own arrangement, or our team can help you book it.
- If you choose not to arrive a day in advance, we can't be held responsible for any acclimatisation issues. Permits are arranged on the assumption that you arrived one day prior.
- No active physical exertion on your first two days in Leh. Have a light meal on the day you arrive.
- Drink at least 2 to 3 litres of water a day and avoid alcohol, smoking and sedatives.
- The itinerary's advisory is Diamox 250 mg (acetazolamide) twice a day, after breakfast and after dinner, starting at least two days before you travel to Leh and continuing for two days after you arrive. Consult your own doctor before the trip.
- If you notice symptoms of HAPE, HACE or AMS, consult a doctor immediately.
- You will be travelling in a high-altitude cold desert with very few medical facilities. We aren't responsible for medical emergencies; we will help arrange logistics if needed, and the expenses are borne by the traveller. Tell us about any existing health issues before you travel.
- Only postpaid mobile connections (Jio, Airtel, BSNL) work in the region.
- Breakfast at the hotel on the last day depends on your departure timing.
- Hotels in Ladakh are more basic than in other parts of the country, and the terrain and weather are harsh and unpredictable.
- Hotels are subject to availability. If a booked hotel is unavailable, you are moved to a comparable property.
- **Any damage to the bike is borne by the rider.**
- Prices are per person. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.
- Bookings can't be transferred. Only the names given at confirmation may travel.
- Look after your own luggage and belongings. We aren't accountable for missing items.
- The departure time is fixed. Keep the trip coordinator updated and report at the pickup point 30 minutes early.
- The departure point and time may change. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.
- The AC is switched off in the hills, and the driver may switch it off whenever needed for safety.
- Drinking and smoking are strictly prohibited during the journey.
- Misconduct or indiscipline isn't tolerated. We are a cordial travel community.
- Travel Devils isn't responsible for delays, changes or extra costs from natural hazards, accidents, breakdowns, weather, landslides, political closures or other incidents. Extra days due to weather or snow road blocks aren't included.
- We don't provide insurance for sickness, accidents, theft or other losses.
- Weather, road conditions and participants' fitness may change the itinerary. We may adjust the schedule in the interest of safety, comfort and well-being.

faqs.q: Where does the trip start and end?
faqs.a: In Leh. Our representative welcomes you on arrival, and pickup and drop are in Leh; you make your own way there.

faqs.q: What are the travel options and what do they cost?
faqs.a: Per person, triple / double sharing: sitting coach (SIC) or RE Himalayan with pillion ₹26,500 / ₹28,500 (the same price by car or as a pillion); RE Himalayan solo rider ₹36,500 / ₹38,500, with your own bike for 6 days and fuel included. 5% GST is extra.
This season's batches leave on 1 Nov and 8 Nov 2026. In 2027, batches run every week from April to early November; call us for dates.

7 nights in hotels, camps and homestays, all meals mentioned in the itinerary, bike rent and fuel (bike option) or Leh to Leh by Tempo / Innova / SUV / Bolero (SIC), a mechanical and luggage backup vehicle with an RE mechanic, inner line permits and the Ladakh union fee, an oxygen cylinder 24x7, a first-aid kit, a bonfire night and a team captain.

5% GST, unspecified meals, room heater charges, entry and monument fees, personal expenses and tips, extra days due to weather or snow road blocks, any damage to the bike and costs from medical emergencies.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Pick your batch and option, then call or WhatsApp us on +91 88008 41209. Reserve your seat with an advance of ₹8,000 per person by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, and pay the balance 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹8,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. The balance is due 24 hours before boarding, and pending payments may cancel the booking. Bookings can't be transferred.
